summary: A proposed 3-story-plus-basement lab/office building at 700 Indiana St in Dogpatch, replacing an existing one-story building, for tenant MBC BioLabs. SF Planning Commission approved the project in June 2024; a neighborhood appeal of its CEQA exemption was rejected by the Board of Supervisors in September 2024, clearing it to proceed. No building permit had been issued as of September 2026.

milestones.text: SF Planning Commission approves the project (Case No. 2023-001074ENX, Motion No. 21576).

SF Board of Supervisors votes 9-1 to uphold the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption, rejecting a neighborhood appeal (Appeal No. 24-040); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote.

costs.what: Estimated construction cost, per secondary reporting -- not independently confirmed against a primary Planning or permit document

facts.value: Dewey Land Company (purchased the site in 2022 for $15,000,000)
MBC BioLabs (expanding from its flagship campus at 953 Indiana St)

Reported as approximately 70,650 sq ft (Planning Commission motion language) or 72,349-72,350 sq ft (CEQA Notice of Exemption and a Feb 2025 news report) -- sources disagree by about 1,700 sq ft; both figures kept rather than picking one. Replaces an existing approximately 15,068 sq ft one-story building on a 0.71-acre (31,090 sq ft) lot.
Reported as either 48 ft (north) / 33 ft (south) per the CEQA filing, or a 54 ft height cap per a Feb 2025 news report -- discrepancy not resolved here.

open_questions: Two different named appeal bodies appear in sources on this project: the Board of Supervisors (which heard and rejected the CEQA exemption appeal, resolved 2024-09-24, the event recorded above) and a separate Board of Appeals item (Appeal No. 24-040, continued to a Nov 13, 2024 hearing) whose subject and outcome could not be confirmed -- not established here whether it is the same matter under a different docket or a genuinely separate appeal.
No construction start date or building permit has been found as of 2026-09-28; status is recorded as planned rather than under_construction pending better evidence.
The gross square footage and height figures differ between the CEQA filing and a Feb 2025 news report; both are kept in facts rather than resolved to one number.
The $40,000,000 estimated construction cost is from secondary reporting only, not independently confirmed against a primary Planning or permit document.
